parsed.rationale: All three `CodingKeys` enums — `Announcement.CodingKeys`, `Breakpoint.CodingKeys`, and `Talkset.CodingKeys` — are flagged as exact duplicates with `shared_field_count: 4` and zero differing slots, meaning they encode precisely the same four coding keys across three distinct types in the same `Playlist` package. Because all records share the same package (`Playlist`) and none carry any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, this is live production duplication with no intentional-specialization justification. The idiomatic Swift resolution is to define a single shared `CodingKeys` enum (e.g., `PlaylistEntryCodingKeys`) within the `Playlist` package and have each conforming type reference it via a `typealias CodingKeys = PlaylistEntryCodingKeys`, eliminating the three redundant declarations. Both source files (`_Plant_Announcement.swift` and `PlaylistEntry.swift`) should have their local `CodingKeys` definitions removed after the shared type is introduced.
